|game_text=FRONT - Imperial Entanglements (V): Deploy Tatooine (with Devastator there) and a non-Jabba's Palace Tatooine battleground site. For remainder of game, you may not deploy systems, non-Imperial characters, non-Imperial starships, or Jabba's Palace sites. While this side up, once per turn, may Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle a Tatooine battleground site. Opponent loses no Force to Tatooine Occupation or your Force drains at Tatooine system. Flip this card if you control three Tatooine sites and opponent controls less than three Tatooine sites. BACK - No One To Stop Us This Time (V): While this side up, wherever you have a trooper 'riding' a dewback, add one battle destiny. Local Trouble may be played at exterior Tatooine sites. Once during your control phase, may peek at the top X cards of your Reserve Deck, where X = number of Tatooine locations you occupy; take one into hand and reshuffle. Opponent's characters require +1 Force to move from Tatooine sites using their landspeed. Flip this card if opponent controls more Tatooine sites than you.
|game_text_note=Game text transcribed from VirtualCards15.pdf slip (local PDF; CDN Sources). Official text as of March 21, 2008. Cover has no separate ICON KEY panel - A/C/S and up/down-triangle Reserve Deck phrases expanded per standard Virtual ICON KEY (A=Immune to Alter; C=Immune to Control; S=Immune to Sense; up-triangle = Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle; down-triangle = Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle; X/pilot-power = Adds X to power of anything he/she pilots). Other slip icons named when clear (Episode I, Rebel, permanent weapon/pilot, ship-docking, set symbols, Force icons). Uniqueness bullet shown as (*). Where the slip footer Decipher base differs from the Virtual title, base is noted. Down-triangle expanded. Footer Decipher objective Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire (V) 50.
